dct_description_sm: The project evaluated the effect of Anuew (prohexadione-calcium) as compared with the industry standard, Primo Maxx (trinexepac-ethyl) on turfgrass growth and quality parameters on both a mature bentgrass-poa annua putting green and fairway height stand of turf. Performance was measured by how the treatments impacted turfgrass growth (clipping production), phytotoxicity where observed, and associated turfgrass quality measures.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: G18-02A+B - Greens and fairway height growth regulator trial - A field study
